name: Accessibility Review
description: Review labels, keyboard use, semantics, focus, and visible contrast from the shared Browser session, and mark recommendations separately from blockers.

permissionsRequired.reason: See labels and contrast as rendered.
Record the URL and viewport of the review.
Move focus by activating a control.

validation.rule: Findings cite the shared Browser session. Recommendations are separated from blocking defects, and contrast or focus claims are limited to what the screenshot or interaction showed.
